name: mast
description: The masthead: the wordmark and the second-row object (the date box or the zoom control). The same height on every destination, so nothing below it moves when you switch (rule 7.6, revision 17). A row at the top of the page at 390 and 834; at 1440 its title form is the column left of the page that also holds the destinations.

form.description: row is the masthead inside the page (was .mast): two lines at 390, one row from 700 that wraps a pushed page's back control onto its own line (revision 21). title is the desktop title block (was .title), a child of the shell beside the page, --title-w wide, sticky in the comps (revisions 33, 36, 39, 45).

collapsed.description: iOS only, once the large title has scrolled away (was .mast.collapsed): a --navh bar with the wordmark at --t-field, centred, ruled underneath.

wordmark.description: "Journal" on a destination, the page's name on a pushed page. One text node, so a rename is one edit (§6 A4). Required in the row form; a desktop pushed page's title block may hold only its back control (03-talk and four others), so the title form renders no wordmark without it.

back.description: Pushed pages only: the back control above the wordmark, on its own line.

children.description: The second-row object, pinned to --ctl by the legacy rules until those components migrate; in the title form also the destinations and the printed line.

places.block: a printed line under the masthead (the glance, the sync line): the page gutter; flush in the title block
places.tool: the date box or the zoom: keeps its size in the row; --s7 below in the title block
places.line: the back control: holds the first line in the row; --s6 below in the title block

states.hover: n/a: the wordmark is text (a link only in the compact recorder, which keeps the legacy link styles); its children carry their own states
states.selected: n/a: the destinations carry the current page
states.loading: n/a: the masthead is drawn before anything loads
states.error: n/a: errors belong to the page's content
states.empty: n/a: a masthead always holds a wordmark, or in the title form at least its back control

a11y.role: row form: a header element (banner). title form: a div, as today (whether it becomes the banner landmark is an open question for the developers)
a11y.labels: the wordmark is the page's h1

responsive.700: row form: one flex row, wordmark and second-row object side by side, wrapping a back control onto its own line; the wordmark loses its bottom margin

changelog.change: Converted from lock.css A4 (.mast, .wordmark), the desktop title block (.title) and the website preview's title rule.
The title block's sticky binding column keys on the container's 1200, no longer on the stage's desktop platform (v4 D1); same weight, no visual change.
seg from the children it accepts and the 'Row with zoom' fixture: Timeline's zoom is gone (v4 C1).

catalogue.note: From 1200 the title form is absolutely positioned down its container (top:0;bottom:0) and takes no height of its own; the frame stands in for the shell.
